parameters.name: n-gpu-layers
parameters.description: Number of model layers offloaded to the GPU; 99 = all.

parameters.name: special
parameters.description: Emit special tokens in the server output.

parameters.name: n-predict
parameters.description: Maximum tokens to generate per completion (OCR page).

parameters.name: ctx-size
parameters.description: Model context window in tokens (prompt + image + output).

parameters.name: parallel
parameters.description: Number of concurrent server slots.

parameters.name: cache-reuse
parameters.description: Context reuse window between requests; 0 disables.

parameters.name: no-context-shift
parameters.description: Keep the context stable: do not shift the KV cache when the window overflows.

parameters.name: cache-type-k
parameters.description: KV cache data type for K; f32 maximizes OCR accuracy.

parameters.name: cache-type-v
parameters.description: KV cache data type for V; f32 maximizes OCR accuracy.

parameters.name: image-min-tokens
parameters.description: Minimum number of vision tokens per image.

parameters.name: image-max-tokens
parameters.description: Maximum number of vision tokens per image.

parameters.name: no-warmup
parameters.description: Skip the warmup run at model load (faster start, slower first request).

parameters.name: flash-attn
parameters.description: Flash attention: on, off or auto.

parameters.name: dry-sequence-breaker
parameters.description: Sequences that end DRY repetition tracking; none resets the default list.
